name: Café Rouge
source:
Isis Black, your average American teenager, happens upon a part time job opening at Café Rouge. During the day, it is your normal quaint café and bakery. When night takes over, it is transformed into a five star restaurant theater café, with live stage performances and mysterious customers coming in the middle of the night.

As Isis delves deeper into this strange café, she becomes tangled in the mystery of its haunted world. Will she find friend or foe? Will she follow fate or make her own destiny? Will she find love? That's for you to decide.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294680/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
伊西斯·布莱克（Isis Black）是一位普通的美国青少年，她偶然发现红咖啡馆有一份兼职工作空缺。白天，这里就是普通的古色古香的咖啡馆和面包店。夜幕降临，这里摇身一变成为五星级餐厅剧场咖啡厅，有现场舞台表演，半夜还有神秘顾客光临。

随着伊西斯深入探索这家奇怪的咖啡馆，她陷入了闹鬼世界的神秘之中。她会找到朋友还是敌人？她会听从命运的安排，还是主宰自己的命运？她会找到爱情吗？这由你决定。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294680/]Steam[/url]]
